item.title: MLS named LAFC co-owner Larry Berg as its next commissioner. Here's what to know
item.description: For their commissioner of the future, MLS owners chose a soccer native. Berg's team is seen as one of MLS's best-run franchises, and he has embraced rule changes designed to modernize the league.
item.content:encoded:

(Image credit: Richard Drew)

item.title: Authorities arrested a man with ammo and apparently monitoring security at Trump golf course near LA
item.description: The Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department said Jeanine John Taele, 38, was taking photos and video and had a 16-round magazine with ammunition in his pocket.

item.title: SpaceX's revenue rises as its once-soaring stock price drifts back to Earth
item.description: On their first earnings call since SpaceX's June public offering, executives said the company is pouring funds into rocket development, Starlink satellites and AI.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: A volunteer's unexpected advice changed how she faced cancer
item.description: After Annabelle Gurwitch was diagnosed with stage 4 lung cancer, a volunteer with the same diagnosis encouraged her to stop worrying so much about the future and start living again.

item.title: House Ethics Committee will investigate Ohio Republican Max Miller
item.description: The committee said it was reviewing allegations that Miller "may have engaged in domestic violence." Miller has denied the allegations, which have swirled around his bid for a third term in Congress.

item.title: 'It's just so fun to make people laugh,' says 'Hacks' star Jean Smart
item.description: The fifth and final season of the HBO Max series Hacks is nominated for 24 Emmys, including one for Smart as best actress in a comedy series. The writers "raised the bar every single season," Smart says.

item.title: The soaring demand for Patriot missiles, from the Middle East to Ukraine
item.description: The U.S. and its partners depend on Patriot interceptors to shoot down incoming ballistic missiles. But Russia and Iran are firing their weapons at rates far higher than Patriots can be produced.

item.title: Senate Democrats say banks turned blind eye to suspicious moves by Jeffrey Epstein
item.description: A report from Senate Democrats accuses big banks of failing to report suspicious money transfers made by Jeffrey Epstein until after his arrest in 2019.

item.description: Europe's heat wave exposes buried history and new threats — Nazi-era wrecks emerge from the Danube, nuclear reactors face cooling risks, and Greece battles deadly wildfires.

item.title: 'Country People' is a silly, satisfying midsummer romp
item.description: Daniel Mason's new novel is a spin on Shakespeare's A Midsummer Night's Dream, in which academics collide with locals — and a few seductive fairies — in the woods of Vermont.
